persistence: generic typed economic codec with pre-class-metadata fallback

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pressure and economic asymmetry require evidence
Qualified money paths require verified payer/payment mechanism
Opportunity priority is registered and formula-traced
Commercial skeptic can KILL no-payment opportunities
Fee-sensitive transaction action cannot bypass control and operator approval
Source activation fails closed on prohibited/restricted conditions
Recursive source discovery creates proposals rather than auto-activation
SourceROI, ActionROI and OpportunityROI are distinct persisted outputs
Major economic learning is blocked below attribution confidence threshold
Capital allocation requires operator approval and cannot exceed deployable capital
Product and marketplace build candidates require repeated payer/liquidity proof
Deterministic fixture replay covers both GO and HOLD behavior
Operator HTTP/UI surface is readable and exposes no consequential write route

source_preservation: existing V1 Money Spine on main is preserved
existing cognitive runtime is not replaced or narrowed
unresolved_items: Live source connectors are not activated by this implementation.
Production PostgreSQL migration execution depends on deployment environment.
Authenticated production operator deployment remains infrastructure work.
Legal enforceability and brokerage/licensing decisions remain jurisdiction-specific review items.
Live external transaction execution remains approval-gated and is not added here.
